items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: in those days, the Basin Street Six were... Roy's dead. Johnny Edwards is dead. Joe Rodas is dead. That doesn't, that leaves three of us. Bunny Franks is still alive. Pete, myself, is still alive.

ctx.x: But, you hear that bartenders never drink, of course. And I happen to know that's not true. I, I've known a few that drink. Yeah. And, they've heard that all musicians get drunk and drunk. Uh, I've heard that also. Yeah. And, uh, not necessarily shout one way or not. Uh-huh.

Uh, in those days, the Basin Street Six were, I, I was very impressionable. But I can remember, on one intermission at the Slipper, band, band, now I was not much of a drinker in those days. Oh. So that left five real two-handed, two-fisted heavyweight drinkers, went through two-fifths of booze in one thirty minute intermission. Now that's, doing some pretty fancy drinking. Let's see, I think, I don't think any of those guys are alive. Now, let's see, Roy's dead. Johnny Edwards is dead. Joe Rodas is dead. That…
Yeah. And I haven't seen Bunny Franks in years, I haven't.
